cultural.vision_reason: Studio portrait of Smutty Bear, a Yankton-Yanktonai Dakota chief, wearing traditional embroidered/quilled warrior clothing, headdress feather, leggings, and moccasins, seated beside an interpreter in Western dress; this documentary photo clearly shows Dakota dress and material culture.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); album
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) from an album; studio portrait of Smutty Bear (Ma-to-sa-bi-tshi-a), a Chief of the Yankton-Yanktonai, sitting on a chair on the right, wearing a feather in his hair, a headband, an embroidered warrior cloak, a pair of embroidered leggings with tassels, a pair of moccasins, a blanket on his lap, and holding a pipe; Charles Picotte sits on a chair on the left, wearing a bow tie, a shirt, a waistcoat, a jacket, a pair of trousers, and a pair of shoes; Washington DC, United States of America. 
Albumen print
